name: Infinite Sands cuts Infinite Clone's cooldown by 60 sec (#1855)
contract: Infinite Sands 500115 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x80000; EffectBasePoints -60001 resolves to -60000 with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Reduces the cooldown of Infinite Clone by $/1000;s1 sec." Infinite Clone 804492 has SpellFamilyFlags word0 524288, RecoveryTime 180000, CategoryRecoveryTime 0 and AttributesEx3 0x100100, not IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, so 180 sec becomes 120 sec. Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod and Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns, which applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to the record's RecoveryTime.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Infinite Clone keeps its 180 sec cooldown without the talent
Infinite Clone's cooldown drops to 120 sec with the talent
